company: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
sector: Steel processing centre (coated steel for appliances)
brlm: Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Private Limited
reference_note: Upper band Rs 82 (RHP; NSE issue page). At Rs 82: 2.23 crore new shares, 6.28 crore post-issue; market cap Rs 515.2 cr; P/E 16.9x FY26 EPS post-issue (10.7x pre-issue; 13.2x pro forma for interest saved); P/B 1.61x; EV/EBITDA 7.0x. Oct-2025 private placement was at Rs 88.

flags: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -68.8% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause
AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: Current free cash flow is negative, so no multiple can be stated: the price assumes cash generation improves from here.

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 82 upper band: Neutral fair value Rs 110 is 34.7% above the price, so the Subscribe limb applies. The DCF alone (Rs 53) is below the price; the blend is carried by peer multiples. No material issue was found.
headline: A four-plant steel processor feeding India's AC and refrigerator makers (FY26 revenue Rs 1,267 cr, up 20%; PAT Rs 30.5 cr), raising Rs 183 cr of fresh money mainly to repay debt, priced at 16.9x FY26 earnings after the issue (13.2x pro forma for lower interest), below the Rs 88 paid by investors in Oct-2025; fair value Rs 110 (Neutral) against Rs 82.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 755.26 cr -> Rs 1,266.82 cr FY24-26 (29.5% CAGR); Q1 FY27 Rs 397.08 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin 8.10% (6.80% in FY26) (pp. 85, 131)
Debt/equity 2.78x (FY26), 2.00x (Jun-26); finance cost 41% of FY26 EBITDA; Rs 125 cr of the issue repays debt (pp. 84-85, 117, 132)
JSW Steel Coated Products 86.65% of FY26 coil supply under a terminable agreement; appliances 86.54% of product revenue; Amber 20.40%, top-10 71.33% (pp. 30-31, 35, 37)
Cumulative CFO/PAT 67% FY24-26 as inventory rose to Rs 189 cr; Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 72.31 cr as it was released (pp. 84, 86)
25 delayed RoC filings and a 2021 allotment-filing error; RoC adjudication still pending; promoter loans Rs 20.55 cr at interest (pp. 32-33, 89-92)
Fair value Rs 103 / 110 / 126 at Rs 82 (Bear / Neutral / Bull); DCF Rs 53 (Neutral) vs peer value Rs 168; reported P/E a fair measure (adjustments -3.1%)

strengths: Plants inside appliance clusters in the West, North and South (p. 240)
Authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products since 2021 (p. 240)
Revenue up from Rs 755.26 cr to Rs 1,266.82 cr in two years (p. 85)
Adjusted EBITDA margin 8.10% in Q1 FY27 (p. 131)
opportunities: Utilisation 59-64% in slitting and cut-to-length leaves room to grow (p. 132)
India steel processing market USD 8.2 bn growing to USD 12.4 bn by CY30 (p. 190)
Lower interest after Rs 125 cr debt repayment (p. 117)
threats: JSW may appoint competing service partners or terminate (p. 31)
Customers buying from mill service centres (part 2)

anchor.source: Anchor bidding 28-Oct-2026; up to Rs 54.9 cr (60% of the QIB portion). The allocation report is on nsearchives.nseindia.com, which is not reachable from this environment.
